evidence.note: Inline radio group in a bordered box choosing config type
Subtle 'Open File' button loads a local file into the textarea; sibling 'Load URL' reveals an inline URL field with fetch button
Action is a client-side conversion between two textareas, not a labelled field set submitted together
JSON is in a plain textarea with no syntax colouring, gutter or folding
Language button toggles English/Chinese directly on click; no menu opens
Two side-by-side panels in a fixed grid, not resizable

structure.layout: single-screen utility tool: full-width blue title bar, two equal side-by-side converter panels (config input left, node links right) each with Paste/Copy, Open File/Load URL/Download toolbar, large textarea and full-width convert button, centered footer

aesthetics.typography: Segoe UI throughout (Fluent UI defaults): bold title in header, semibold panel headings and buttons, regular body/textarea text; textareas use the proportional UI font rather than monospace
aesthetics.typeScale: 32px bold page title, 24px semibold panel headings, 16px semibold convert buttons, 14px body/buttons/textarea, 12px toolbar buttons, subtitle and footer; restrained hierarchy

notes: Built with Microsoft Fluent UI v9 (brand blue #0f6cbd, Segoe UI, 4px radii, #d1d1d1 1px borders). Symmetric two-pane converter: each pane mirrors the other (Paste secondary + Copy primary buttons top-right, subtle icon toolbar Open File / Load URL / Download, 396px textarea, full-width primary convert button with arrow pointing toward the other pane — '→' on left, '←' on right). Load URL expands an inline URL input + fetch button + close X above the textarea. Header is a solid brand-blue band with only two icon buttons (language toggle EN/中文 switches immediately, theme toggle). Very long prefilled content scrolls inside the textareas; page itself is a single screen with footer below a grey-white content area.
